meta.title: Workspace activity order
meta.description: Keeps the workspace list ordered by the most recently used session: the workspace you last sent a message in moves to the top, and the other workspaces keep their relative order. A workspace's «…» menu also offers «Keep workspace at top», which holds it in front no matter what you use elsewhere; the pin is stored in this browser and kept by the open page, and the same menu item releases it. Automatic sorting overwrites the positions you drag by hand, on the next message or a restart; turn the plugin off in Settings → Plugins to keep your own order.
